sources.title: Efficient and Robust Drafting with Multi-Token Prediction
sources.snippet: Speculative decoding has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation into a drafting phase and a parallel verification phase. A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model. We present a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction ...

sources.snippet: RavenX MTP Drafter ⚡🐦‍⬛ — Multi-Token Prediction for Any Model Model-agnostic Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) drafter for speculative decoding on Apple Silicon. Architecture extracted from Google's hidden Gemma 4 MTP heads (stripped from public release, recovered from LiteRT by SeatownSin). Extended to be model-agnostic and MLX-native.
